{{Top|leg}}
At some point by [[580 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] launched a '''diplomatic mission to Yanibar''', which was an unsuccessful visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yanibar]] in order to convince members of its [[Zeison Sha]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] tradition to ally themselves with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
